players.name: PJ Dozier
players.note: PJ Dozier is out for 2-3 weeks with a back injury.

players.name: Mike James
players.note: Mike James suffered an Achilles injury in Round 3 that will see him sidelined for 7-9 months.

players.name: Isaia Cordinier
players.note: Isaia Cordinier remains sidelined after undergoing surgery in May, as was announced on May 18.

players.name: Georgios Papagiannis
players.note: Georgios Papagiannis injured his ACL in October 2025 and has been recovering ever since.

players.name: Lonnie Walker
players.note: New signing Lonnie Walker has been registered and could make his debut in Round 7.

players.name: DaQuan Jeffries
players.note: DaQuan Jeffries suffered a wrist injury in Round 1 and had to undergo surgery. He has missed the last four rounds.

players.name: Tobias Jensen
players.note: Tobias Jensen, Rokas Jokubaitis and Johannes Voigtmann were not on the gameday roster in Round 6, but all three played in the German Cup this past weekend.

players.name: Dzanan Musa
players.note: Dzanan Musa is yet to play so far this season.

players.name: Iffe Lundberg

players.name: Gaby Deck
players.note: Gaby Deck (shoulder) last played in Round 3, with coach Pedro Martinez saying ahead of Round 4: "The injury is more serious than we thought."

players.name: Usman Garuba

players.name: Kendrick Nunn
